groupings.title: Orca orchestration
groupings.description: Skills for orchestrating multi-agent work on Orca: project setup, plan-first brainstorm, plan-to-task cutting, the coordinator DAG runbook, read-only status sweeps, durable project handoff/resume, free terminal-driven TUI workers, and the supervised worker + orchestrator agents.

groupings.title: Forge — product & engineering lifecycle
groupings.description: Multi-use skills distilled from the BMad Method: pressure-test ideas, work backwards through PRFAQs, briefs, PRDs, specs, architecture, UX, research, reviews, retrospectives, course corrections, sprint planning, e2e tests, and agent-context authoring. Standalone — no BMad install required.
